sources.name: openai_news
sources.notes: OpenAI article pages reject this crawler with HTTP 403. Keep official RSS summaries as partial records without repeating known-failing page requests.

sources.name: google_deepmind_blog
sources.notes: Community-maintained XML mirror of the official DeepMind blog. Its pubDate values are month-granularity placeholders, so every entry must use the official page publication date and remain on deepmind.google or blog.google.

sources.name: physical_intelligence_blog
sources.notes: Official sitemap lists blog URLs on physicalintelligence.company, which redirect to the current pi.website domain; article pages expose article:published_time.

sources.name: generalist_blog
sources.notes: No official RSS or sitemap. The server-rendered blog listing provides article links and visible publish dates, which are authoritative because article pages lack date metadata.

sources.name: perceptron_blog
sources.notes: Framer site without RSS; sitemap lacks lastmod and article pages lack date metadata. The server-rendered blog listing provides article links and visible publish dates.

sources.name: meta_ai_newsroom
sources.notes: ai.meta.com has no usable official feed and its robots policy restricts automation. Use Meta's official Newsroom sitemap and keep only AI-related articles based on page title, description, keywords, and body.
